page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 2 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The x86_64 architecture is paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong single-core performance, as evidenced by top-tier scores in stress-ng single-core CPU tests, Geekbench single-core metrics, and text processing. However, multi-core and parallel execution benchmarks, such as multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, and Ray Tracing, fall into the lower performance tier. General multi-core CPU metrics, image processing, and cryptographic operations remain in the average range.

Given its high memory density relative to the vCPU count, the ecs.r8ae.xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require significant memory footprints but moderate compute power. It is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, caching layers, and lightweight database workloads that do not demand high local disk IOPS or intensive multi-threaded processing.
